test_escape_mdv2: test the _escape_mdv2 function to escape all MarkdownV2 special characters like underscores, asterisks, and parentheses
test_format_message_basic: test the format_message method to convert plain text and escape special characters for Telegram MarkdownV2
test_format_message_code_blocks: test the format_message method to preserve code block contents without escaping while escaping surrounding text
test_format_message_markdown_conversion: test the format_message method to convert bold, italic, strikethrough, spoiler, and headers to MarkdownV2 syntax
test_format_message_blockquotes: test the format_message method to preserve blockquote markers while escaping mid-line greater-than symbols
test_format_message_tables: test the format_message method to wrap pipe tables in code fences and prevent MarkdownV2 pipe escaping
test_strip_mdv2: test the _strip_mdv2 function to remove MarkdownV2 formatting markers and escape backslashes for plaintext output
test_wrap_markdown_tables: test the _wrap_markdown_tables function to detect GFM pipe tables and wrap them in fenced code blocks
test_send_markdownv2_chunking: test the TelegramAdapter.send method to chunk long messages and append MarkdownV2-safe chunk indicators
